t: 安多克皇帝继位为日本王位.
te: Emperor Antoku accedes to the throne of Japan.
dz: 安多克皇帝继位为日本王位.
de: Emperor Antoku accedes to the throne of Japan.

t: 第一次乌地战役,开始日本源北会战.
te: First Battle of Uji, starting the Genpei War in Japan.
dz: 第一次乌地战役,开始日本源北会战.
de: First Battle of Uji, starting the Genpei War in Japan.

t: 在日本石桥山之战中，源氏新任武将源赖朝被平氏大场影亲击溃。
te: In the Battle of Ishibashiyama in Japan, the new military commander of the Minamoto clan, Minamoto no Yoritomo, is rout…
dz: 源平之战：在日本石桥山之战中，源氏新任武将源赖朝被平氏大场影亲击溃。
de: Genpei War: In the Battle of Ishibashiyama in Japan, the new military commander of the Minamoto clan, Minamoto no Yoritomo, is routed by Ōba Kagechika of the Taira clan.

t: 菲利普·奥古斯都于15岁成为法国国王.
te: Philip Augustus becomes king of France at the age of fifteen.
dz: 菲利普·奥古斯都于15岁成为法国国王.
de: Philip Augustus becomes king of France at the age of fifteen.

t: 由米纳本所辖的米纳本部队(30,000人)没有约里托莫在富士河附近的夜袭中击败了塔伊拉和科雷莫…
te: Minamoto forces (30,000 men) under Minamoto no Yoritomo defeat Taira no Koremori during a night attack near the Fuji Ri…
dz: 藤川之战:由米纳本所辖的米纳本部队(30,000人)没有约里托莫在富士河附近的夜袭中击败了塔伊拉和科雷莫里,但他与被路过的军队安全地逃出.
de: The Battle of Fujigawa: Minamoto forces (30,000 men) under Minamoto no Yoritomo defeat Taira no Koremori during a night attack near the Fuji River but he escapes safely with the routed army.
